BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to jury selection; and amending RCW 2.36.065 and2.36.093.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.36.065 and 1993 c 408 s 7 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It shall be the duty of the judges of the superior court to ensurecontinued random selection of the master jury list and jury panels,which shall be done ((without)) with regard to whether a person's nameoriginally appeared on the list of registered voters, or on the list oflicensed drivers and identicard holders, or both. If a person's nameoriginally appeared on the list of registered voters, or on the list oflicensed drivers and identicard holders, or both, then his or her nameshall not appear again on the master jury list until each and everyregistered voter, licensed driver, and identicard holder who resides inthe county has been summoned for jury service. The judges shall reviewthe process from time to time and shall cause to be kept on file withthe county clerk a description of the jury selection process. Anyperson who desires may inspect this description in said office. p. 1 SB 6329 Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as requiring uniformequipment or method throughout the state, so long as fair and randomselection of the master jury list and jury panels is achieved.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 2.36.093 and 1992 c 93 s 3 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) At such time as the judge or judges of any court of any countyshall deem that the public business requires a jury term to be held,the judge or judges shall direct that a jury panel be selected andsummoned to serve for the ensuing jury term or terms. (2) A person who has been summoned for jury service shall not besummoned to serve again as a juror until all persons listed on themaster jury list have been summoned for service. (3) The court shall establish the length and number of jury termsin a consecutive twelvemonth period, and shall establish the time ofjuror service consistent with the provisions of RCW 2.36.010.
